official_cash_flows.note: Quarterly figures (USD thousands) derived by differencing the year-to-date statements of cash flows / operations in the three fiscal-2026 10-Qs (fiscal year ended Aug 31). Bitmine reclassified option-contract cash flows from operating (6-month statement) to investing (9-month statement), so the Dec–May combined column is the cleanest. FY2026 10-K (filed Nov 10, 2026) adds the full-year column; Jun–Aug is FY minus the 9-month figures where both exist.

periods.note: Operating cash flow: FY −$305,149K − 9-month −$287,592K = −$17,557K. Digital-asset purchases: FY $12,553,572K − 9-month $11,687,493K. Option premiums: FY paid $125,262K / received $121,388K vs 9-month paid $124,584K / received $103,938K. Non-cash staking: FY $112,662K − Dec–May $52,493K = $60,169K (the 9-month staking figure used here is the Dec–May combined column, not Sep–May). Buybacks of $353,845K and the BMNP issuance are full-year amounts (all occurred by Aug 31; buybacks were not isolated to Q4).
From the FY2026 10-K consolidated statement of cash flows (USD thousands). No separate option-collateral line; no open derivative contracts at August 31, 2026 (Note on derivatives).
